title: One non-blocking line reader for Hyprland events and channel clients
body:
`viewer.rs` has a 40-line calloop closure that reads the Hyprland event socket in `[0u8; 4096]` chunks, handles `Ok(0)` and `WouldBlock`, and drains lines at `position(b'\n')` before calling `hypr::wants_recount`. The channel client reader in `compositor.rs` is the same loop over socket lines. `read_lines` in `decade-channel` is a blocking cousin. `hypr.rs` owns the event format and `events()` but not the reading.

## Proposal

One line reader shared by both, with `hypr.rs` owning the Hyprland read and `viewer.rs` keeping only `recount_alone`.
close_reason: Landed in b993aaf. src/lines.rs holds Lines, used by the channel client reader and the Hyprland event reader. The note explains why the Hyprland registration stays in viewer.rs. read_lines in decade-channel stays blocking on its own thread.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/913b1d2c
notes.text: The Hyprland source stays registered in `viewer.rs`, not `hypr.rs`. Moving the registration into `hypr.rs` would need it to take a `LoopHandle` over the viewer's private `Viewer` type, or a type parameter with one instantiation. `hypr.rs` keeps the event format (`wants_recount`) and `events()`. The closure in `watch_hyprland` is now eight lines over `Lines::read`.
